items.title: BRICS Leaders Meet in India for Annual Summit
items.summary: BRICS leaders convened in India for their summit amidst global conflicts and international tensions. The meeting highlighted India's diplomatic efforts to balance ties with Russia, Iran, the U.S., and Europe.

items.title: BRICS Summit Issues New Delhi Declaration
items.summary: The BRICS summit chaired by the Prime Minister issued the New Delhi Declaration, calling for maximum restraint in ongoing wars and emphasizing peace.

items.title: India-Russia Bilateral Trade Target Set at $100 Billion by 2030
items.summary: India and Russia have set a bilateral trade target of $100 billion to be achieved by the year 2030.

items.title: Endangered Pygmy Hog Population Reaches 194 via Captive Breeding
items.summary: The population of the endangered pygmy hog has increased from six in 1996 to 194 through a captive breeding programme in Assam.

items.title: PM Modi and President Xi Welcome Progress in India-China Bilateral Relations
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping welcomed steady progress in India-China bilateral relations. PM Modi stated that peace and tranquillity in border areas are essential for bilateral development, while President Xi referred to both nations as key Global South countries with significant responsibilities.

items.title: Rajasthan High Court Rules Resigned Govt Employees Contesting Polls Cannot Seek Reinstatement
items.summary: The Rajasthan High Court ruled that a government employee who quits to contest elections cannot seek reinstatement in service. The court upheld the Central Administrative Tribunal's finding that contesting an election as a political party candidate violates the requirement of maintaining political neutrality.

items.title: BRICS Leaders Stress Health Cooperation in New Delhi Declaration
items.summary: BRICS leaders called for stronger cooperation in disease surveillance and medical product regulation in their New Delhi Declaration. They stressed the importance of strengthening health infrastructure and local production to enhance preparedness for future health emergencies.

items.title: 'Woman Unknown' Wins Top Prize at Venice Film Festival
items.summary: 'Woman Unknown' won the top prize at the Venice Film Festival, while John Malkovich was named best actor. Additionally, an Israeli-made Gaza documentary was awarded the special jury prize.

items.title: India Reaches Junior Women’s Asia Cup Final with 5-1 Win Over South Korea
items.summary: India advanced to the final of the Junior Women’s Asia Cup after defeating South Korea 5-1, powered by a hat-trick from Supriya. India will face the winner of the second semifinal between hosts China and Japan in the summit clash.

items.title: OPU-IVF Calf Born in Badri Cattle Breed Conservation Milestone
items.summary: An OPU-IVF calf was born in Badri cattle, marking a major milestone in indigenous breed conservation.

items.title: Colombo Security Conclave Table Top Exercise Concludes in Visakhapatnam
items.summary: The Table Top Exercise under the Colombo Security Conclave concluded in Visakhapatnam.

items.title: Southern Railway Achieves 100% Electrification
items.summary: Southern Railway has successfully achieved 100% electrification across its routes.

items.title: Defence Ministry report notes S-400 air-defence engagement in Operation Sindoor
items.summary: According to the Defence Ministry's annual report, the S-400 air-defence system destroyed a Pakistani aircraft at a range of 314 km during Operation Sindoor. The report highlighted the engagement as a demonstration of the Indian Air Force's long-range air-defence capability.

items.title: Dhiraj Wins Historic Men’s Recurve Gold at Archery World Cup Final
items.summary: Dhiraj won a historic men’s recurve gold medal at the Saltillo World Cup Final by defeating Japan's Nakanishi Junya 6-5 in a tie-breaker shoot-off.

items.title: India Wins Record-Extending Eighth Women’s Asia Cup Title
items.summary: India defeated Sri Lanka by 72 runs in the final to clinch a record-extending eighth Women’s Asia Cup title.

items.title: India Defeats Korea 4-1 to Win Record Sixth Asia Cup Title
items.summary: India defeated Korea 4-1 to lift the continental Asia Cup title for a record sixth time, having previously won in 2004, 2008, 2015, 2023, and 2024.

items.title: UN Secretary-General Clarifies Position on UN Maps Following India's Objections
items.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres stated that there is no official 'UN map with borders' after India pointed out anomalies in a map used by the United Nations. The issue was raised by India during the UN's 'Correct the Map' resolution.

items.title: India restarts discussions for India-Africa Forum Summit on BRICS sidelines
items.summary: India has restarted discussions on the next India-Africa Forum Summit following talks held by Prime Minister Modi with leaders from the African continent. The bilateral outreach discussions took place on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit.

items.title: IAF's Surya Kiran Aerobatic Team to perform at Meerut airshow
items.summary: The Indian Air Force's Surya Kiran Aerobatic Team (SKAT) is scheduled to perform aerobatic displays at an airshow in Meerut. The performance will highlight precision manoeuvres including inverted flying, loops, and barrel rolls.

items.title: Alexander Zverev Wins U.S. Open Title
items.summary: Alexander Zverev defeated eighth seed Ben Shelton to win the U.S. Open men's singles title.

items.title: Tanvi Patri Wins U17 Title at Badminton Asia Junior Championships
items.summary: Tanvi Patri defeated Shaina Manimuthu 11-15, 15-10, 15-12 in an all-Indian final to win the U17 title at the Badminton Asia Junior Championships.

items.title: Union Home Minister Amit Shah Delivers Message on Hindi Diwas 2026
items.summary: Union Minister of Home Affairs and Cooperation Shri Amit Shah issued an official message on the occasion of Hindi Diwas 2026.

items.title: Government Notifies Changes Under Payment and Settlement Act, 2007 for UPI Charges
items.summary: The government notified changes under the Payment and Settlement Act, 2007, keeping UPI transactions up to ₹2,000 free of charges. A decision regarding the Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) for higher-value payments is yet to be finalized.

items.title: U.S. Lawmaker Proposes Amendment Naming India in Russia Sanctions Act
items.summary: An amendment naming India was submitted in the Lindsey O Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which was passed by the U.S. Senate by an 86-11 vote. The act targets Russia's leadership, energy sector, and shadow fleet vessels used to evade oil sanctions.

items.title: India Approves Expedited Electricity Export to Nepal
items.summary: India's Ministry of Power has approved the expedited export of electricity to flood-hit Nepal to meet its power requirements. The initiative aims to strengthen energy cooperation between the two nations.

items.title: Justice V. Kameswar Rao Sworn In as Chief Justice of Patna High Court
items.summary: Justice V. Kameswar Rao has taken the oath of office as the Chief Justice of the Patna High Court. The ceremony took place at Lok Bhavan in the presence of Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary.

items.title: India and Canada Resume Talks for Proposed Bilateral Trade Pact
items.summary: India and Canada have initiated the next round of negotiations for a proposed trade agreement. Both countries have set a target to increase their bilateral trade to $50 billion by the year 2030.

items.title: Wholesale Price Index Inflation Rises to 9.92% in August
items.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation increased to 9.92% in August owing to rising prices of food, fuel, and manufactured items. WPI inflation in manufactured items hit a series high of 8.37%, rising from 8.29% recorded in July.

items.title: West Asia war LIVE: Saudi Arabia warns it will react 'firmly' to Houthi attacks
items.summary: Saudi Arabian ‌Civil Defence sent an alert on September 15, ​after issuing alerts for potential danger ‌in six cities, including Yanbu, ‌the kingdom's ‌main ⁠Red Sea oil ⁠port, where millions of barrels a day ​are loaded

items.title: Pakistan court orders blocking passports of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa CM, 24 lawmakers of Imran Khan's party
items.summary: The order comes amid heightened political activity by the PTI, which has announced a nationwide protest for September 27

items.title: Drone shot down by NATO over Lithuania
items.summary: Baltic states Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia — NATO members sharing a long border with Russia — regularly report drone incursions into their territories as part of Moscow's war with Ukraine.

items.title: Pakistan mulls revival of austerity measures amid West Asia hostilities
items.summary: The indication of a possible revival of austerity measures came as petrol prices rose to PKR 375.82 per litre and high-speed diesel (HSD) to PKR 403.32 per litre

items.title: Trump nominates Wesley Hunt to serve as U.S. Ambassador to Saudi; picks wife of 'God Bless the USA' singer as envoy to Barbados
items.summary: The Republican lawmaker is near the end of his second term representing his Houston-area district and has served as a U.S. Army officer who served as a diplomatic liaison in Saudi Arabia

items.title: Asian Games venues and athletes unharmed by extensive flooding in Nagoya, Japan
items.summary: Hirosawa said about 400 athletes and staff who are staying in converted shipping containers — remodeled to serve as temporary housing units for the Asian Games — were briefly evacuated to higher ground during the heavy rain

items.title: Who is fugitive Khadeer Khan Mohammed? | Explained
items.summary: Why is Khadeer Khan Mohammed wanted by U.S. authorities in an alleged $93 million Medicare genetic-testing fraud case? What is the status of the investigation that began in 2025? What could happen next if he is in India?

items.title: How EU plans to keep children under 15 off social media
items.summary: Under a proposal being prepared by the European Commission, children under 15 could face restrictions on creating and using accounts across a wide range of digital services

items.title: Remembering Dolly Parton, who gave away everything but her songs
items.summary: The Queen of Country Music, who passed away recently, gave away more than 300 million books and millions of dollars in aid, but refused to surrender the copyright to one song, even for Elvis Presley.

items.title: U.S. has weapons deployed in orbit, Space Force says
items.summary: "The U.S. has on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action," a U.S. Space Force spokesperson said in a statement that did not provide specifics on the weapons

items.title: Houthi attack in southern Saudi Arabia wounds 13: Riyadh-led coalition
items.summary: "On September 14, the Militia launched attacks on civilian objects in the cities of Khamis Mushait, Abha, and Taif with several ballistic missiles and drones,” says coalition spokesman

items.title: Trump says there is ‘SICK conspiracy’ against AI and data centres, dismisses new guardrails
items.summary: “The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!” Mr. Trump said

items.title: In loss for Trump, U.S. Supreme Court won't let Postal Service restrict mail ballots
items.summary: Justice Samuel Alito, joined by fellow conservative Justice Clarence Thomas, dissented from the decision, comparing some ‌of the challengers’ claims to a “Hail Mary pass” that is “unlikely to be successfully completed,” using a football analogy

items.title: NATO fighter jet shoots down drone in Lithuania
items.summary: Origin yet to be determined; drone alert was issued earlier in ​the capital ‌Vilnius and surrounding region.

items.title: BRICS: A strategic balancer?
items.summary: BRICS: A strategic balancer?

items.title: Police arrest man after multiple people wounded in China knife attack
items.summary: A video seemingly captured from CCTV showed a man in a face mask stabbing a woman in the face as he walked past her in front of a restaurant.

items.title: U.S. Judge blocks Trump limits on duration of visas for foreign students, journalists
items.summary: U.S. ​Department of Homeland Security adopted the policy ‌based on “exceptionally weak” rationales, the Judge said

items.title: Houthis say Saudi Arabia hits Yemen with 54 strikes after attack on bases
items.summary: Saudi civil defence issued a brief alert for Najran in southwestern Saudi Arabia without elaborating on the cause for the warning

items.title: Russia hits petrol station, warehouse facilities in Kyiv, Mayor says
items.summary: Russia has recently ‌started hitting petrol stations in Kyiv, expanding the range of target facilities. In recent months, Russia hit some 300 petrol stations, mainly in or near ‌Ukraine’s frontline regions.

items.title: French power sector labour strike takes 6.5 gigawatts offline overnight
items.summary: Workers ‌and retirees in the French energy sector pay discounted rates, which their unions view as a core part of their compensation package; strike is expected to go ⁠through the day on September 15, suggesting the outages could be renewed or increased

items.title: India-US Military Exercise Yudh Abhyas 2026 Begins at Auli and Mahajan
items.summary: The joint India-US military exercise Yudh Abhyas 2026 has begun at Auli and Mahajan.

items.title: Six States and UT Sign Agreement for Kishau Multipurpose Project on Tons River
items.summary: Six States and a Union Territory have signed an agreement for the Kishau multipurpose project. The project will be located on the Tons river along the border of Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh.

items.title: New Zealand Parliament Passes Trade Deal with India to Cut Tariffs
items.summary: The Parliament of New Zealand has passed a trade agreement with India designed to reduce tariffs on most exports. Under the deal, more than half of all covered products will become duty-free from the day it takes effect.

items.title: 18th BRICS Summit Held in New Delhi
items.summary: India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, which highlighted its role in global governance reforms, trade cooperation, and international diplomacy. The meeting concluded with key outcomes framed around the New Delhi Declaration.

items.title: Mazagon Dock Plans ₹27,000 Crore Shipbuilding Cluster in Raigad
items.summary: Mazagon Dock has planned a new shipbuilding cluster in Raigad with an investment of ₹27,000 crore.

items.title: Defence Ministry Unveils Policy Initiatives for MSMEs and Start-ups at VIMARSH
items.summary: The Ministry of Defence announced key policy initiatives for MSMEs and start-ups at the VIMARSH event.

items.title: U.S. House Advances Russia Sanctions Bill Proposing 100% Tariffs on India
items.summary: The U.S. House of Representatives passed a resolution by a 214-211 vote to advance a Russia sanctions bill that proposes 100% tariffs on India and other nations. The legislation is scheduled for a final vote in the House on September 16.

items.title: Indian Army Chief Dhiraj Seth Visits Russia to Deepen Defence Ties
items.summary: Indian Army Chief Dhiraj Seth traveled to Russia to strengthen bilateral defence ties. A key focus of the discussions is the availability of spare parts and supplies for Russian-origin military equipment used by the Indian Army.

items.title: India Revises Measurement of Nominal GDP
items.summary: India has revised its nominal GDP calculation methodology to enhance economic tracking. The revision is primarily driven by the improved measurement of the country's unincorporated services sector.

items.title: India's Goods Exports Surge by 26% to Reduce Trade Deficit
items.summary: India recorded a 26% surge in goods exports, which helped lower the August 2026 trade deficit. According to Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal, merchandise export growth surpassed import growth in both percentage and absolute terms for the first time.

items.title: Two New Frog Species Discovered in Mizoram
items.summary: Scientists have identified two new frog species in Mizoram named Duttaphrynus phawngpui and Ingerana aizawl. The species are named after Mizoram's highest peak and its capital city, respectively.

items.title: 46th Chess Olympiad Commences in Samarkand
items.summary: The 46th edition of the Chess Olympiad has commenced in Samarkand, featuring 208 nations in the open section and 191 in the women's section. The tournament is being played over 11 rounds in the Swiss system.

items.title: Dhiraj Wins Archery World Championship Final Gold Title
items.summary: Dhiraj won the gold medal title at the World Championship Final in archery. He became the second Indian archer to win a title in the event following Dola Banerjee's feat in 2007.

items.title: Sree Charani Breaks Record for Highest ICC Rating Points by an Indian
items.summary: Sree Charani achieved the highest ICC ranking points ever recorded by an Indian across both batting and bowling categories. She surpassed former skipper Mithali Raj's previous batting rating record of 780 points set in 2011.

items.title: Asian Games Scheduled to Take Place in Aichi-Nagoya Region
items.summary: The Asian Games will be held in Nagoya and the wider Aichi area from September 19 to October 4. Around 15,000 competitors and officials are expected to participate in the event.

items.title: Indian Women's Cricket Team Defeats England in Historic Test at Lord's
items.summary: The Indian women's cricket team registered a historic milestone by winning their first-ever women's Test match at Lord's against England. Following the victory, the team is set to focus on the UAE Asia Cup T20.

items.title: Odisha Receives ₹3,406 Crore SiC Semiconductor Facility
items.summary: A SiC semiconductor facility valued at ₹3,406 crore is being set up in Odisha.

items.title: Bharat Forge and Pratt & Whitney Partner for DRDO UAV Programme
items.summary: Bharat Forge has partnered with Pratt & Whitney for the DRDO UAV programme.

items.title: World Circular Economy Forum 2026 Begins in Gandhinagar
items.summary: The World Circular Economy Forum 2026 has officially commenced in Gandhinagar.

items.title: Union Cabinet Raises EPFO Wage Ceiling to ₹25,000
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved an increase in the EPFO wage ceiling to ₹25,000.

items.title: Anant Nag Selected for Dadasaheb Phalke Award
items.summary: Actor Anant Nag has been chosen to receive the prestigious Dadasaheb Phalke Award.

items.title: Delhi Tops NITI Aayog's Electric Mobility Index
items.summary: Delhi has ranked first in the Electric Mobility Index released by NITI Aayog.

items.title: APEDA Signs MoU with Gulfood Organiser for Food Trade
items.summary: APEDA has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the organiser of Gulfood to strengthen global food trade.

items.title: Oman Promotes Sohar Port as Energy Route for India
items.summary: Oman is promoting Sohar Port as India's Gulf energy route.

items.title: U.S. House Passes Bill Authorising Tariffs on Russian Oil Buyers
items.summary: The U.S. House of Representatives passed a bill authorising up to 100% tariffs on countries including India for purchasing oil and gas from Russia.

items.title: Swachh Seva Aankalan Launched under Swachh Bharat Mission-Grameen
items.summary: The Swachh Seva Aankalan initiative has been launched under the Swachh Bharat Mission-Grameen.

items.title: Project Cheetah Completes Four Years in India
items.summary: India's Project Cheetah wildlife initiative has completed four years of operation.

items.title: Centre Reconstitutes Central Board of Film Certification
items.summary: The Central Government has reconstituted the Central Board of Film Certification with 18 members.

items.title: J&K MLAs decry 18% representation to Kashmir valley in UT officers’ list
items.summary: J&K CM Omar Abdullah distributed appointment orders to 55 newly selected candidates of the Combined Competitive Examination entering the Jammu & Kashmir Administrative Service and Jammu & Kashmir Accounts (Gazetted) Service

items.title: Uttar Pradesh ATS arrests Tamil Nadu youth for allegedly planning terror activities
items.summary: Maqsood Ali, who was allegedly in touch with Pakistani hackers and had developed a secure communication network for others like him, was arrested from Coimbatore with the assistance of Tamil Nadu ATS

items.summary: Expressing concern over the move, the All India Gem and Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC) urged the government and BIS to immediately review the decision and retain the existing charge pending stakeholder consultation

items.summary: Experts share innovations, experiences at the ‘Empowering Futures’ programme in Lucknow

items.summary: Why is Rahul Gandhi opposing something his own MPs, including former finance minister P.Chidambaram and former minister in the UPA government Manish Tewari supported within the parliamentary panel, says a senior government functionary

items.summary: He also met Indian High Commissioner Kumaran Periyasamy and held discussions on joint ventures between India and the U.K. under the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement.

items.summary: Nabrangpur MP Balabhadra Majhi, Bolangir MP Sangeeta Kumari Singh Deo and Kantabanji MLA Laxman Bag’s letters is said to put the Mohan Charan Majhi government in an uncomfortable position

items.summary: As part of the exercise, CJP representatives will visit tribal schools and inspect the facilities and infrastructure; Abhijeet Dipke tears up copy of MoU between Maharashtra govt., trust over tribal hostels

items.title: NEET-UG protests: Supreme Court refuses change in High-Powered Enquiry Committee, says inquiry on pellet guns, excesses must come first
items.summary: The court expressed a sense of chagrin that the disparagement from the petitioners’ side had commenced even before the HPEC had started work

items.title: J&K CM Omar Abdullah backs Centre on UPI charges
items.summary: Asserting that maintaining and operating the UPI infrastructure is not cheap, the Chief Minister said it takes a substantial amount of money to run the payment system

items.title: ICE agent charged with assault, lying about shooting, arrested in Minnesota
items.summary: But a lawyer for the ICE agent, Rolando Cantu, said ‌in an interview that his client always intended to answer the charges in Minneapolis.

items.title: Federal Reserve hikes key rate to tackle ‘too high’ inflation, defying Trump demands for cut
items.summary: Chairperson Warsh said renewed U.S.-Iran combat, which has driven up gas prices, also convinced officials to support rate hikes; President Trump reacted angrily to the decision, renewing his call for the Fed to lower interest rates “AND FAST”

items.title: EU chief offers Canada ‘Associate Membership’ of bloc
items.summary: Canadian PM Mark Carney has been pursuing closer ties with the European Union, as both seek to pivot away from a hostile United States under President Donald Trump.

items.title: EU to ban social media for under 13s, curb access until 15
items.summary: The European Commission president and tech chief Henna Virkkunen will formally present the proposed “KIDS Act”, including the tiered age limits in Strasbourg, France, on September 16, 2026

items.title: Parliament Standing Committee didn’t discuss MDR charges on UPI transactions, says Gaurav Gogoi
items.summary: The Congress MP said that government representatives did not provide any ‘specific or satisfactory’ answers on the need for the new UPI charges

items.summary: Drawing comparisons with institutions such as the Institute for Fiscal Studies in the UK and the International Bureau of Fiscal Documentation in Amsterdam, Sitharaman said India needed more visible and rigorous independent tax policy research

items.title: ‘PM has redefined NOTA — Narendra’s Ongoing Trump Appeasement’: Congress after UPI move
items.summary: Jairam Ramesh asked whether the government's move on MDR was done to enable U.S. card companies to compete with UPI

items.title: Nabi, Dhir get maiden ODI call-ups for West Indies series
items.summary: Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli and Ravindra Jadeja are all part of the ODI series against the men from the Caribbean, providing vast experience to the Shubman Gill-led squad

items.title: Government is ‘surrendering to American pressure’ with UPI charges, Rahul Gandhi alleges; Kharge terms it ‘loot’
items.summary: The move is aimed at opening the digital payments sector to American companies, the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha says, alleging that a recent notification has quietly paved the way for imposing a Merchant Discount Rate on merchant transactions above ₹2,000

items.title: PM decided to prostrate before Trump, says Rahul on UPI charge
items.summary: The Congress has sought to link the UPI decision to what it describes as growing U.S. pressure on India, including demands for changes to the zero merchant discount rate regime for UPI

items.title: Spurious drug racket accused had shop near Minerva Circle in Bengaluru; SIT gets custody
items.summary: One of the two main accused in the case is Veeresh Kumar Jain, a native of Rajasthan and proprietor of Krupa Healthcare near Minerva Circle in Bengaluru

items.title: HAL Airport Becomes India's First to Operationalise RNP CAT H Helicopter Approach System
items.summary: HAL Airport has become the first airport in India to operationalise the RNP CAT H helicopter approach procedure. The system uses a satellite-guided precision navigation system engineered specifically for helicopter operations.

items.title: Elena Rybakina Wins US Open Title and Ascends to World No. 1
items.summary: Elena Rybakina won the US Open title by defeating the top seed and two-time defending champion in the final. Following her victory, she ascended to the World No. 1 ranking in women's tennis.

items.title: Union Cabinet Approves ₹24,815 Crore Multi-Tracking Railway Projects in U.P. and Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved multi-tracking railway projects worth ₹24,815 crore across 15 districts in Uttar Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh. The project will expand the Indian Railways network by about 601 km and includes the ₹14,926 crore Ghaziabad-Sitapur line to enhance connectivity between northern and eastern India.

items.title: Union Cabinet Approves ₹9,889 Crore Railway Line Projects in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has sanctioned new railway lines in Andhra Pradesh valued at ₹9,889 crore, featuring 198-km-long third and fourth lines between Rajahmundry and Visakhapatnam. The expansion aims to enhance port connectivity, boost tourism, and handle an additional freight traffic of 29.04 million tonnes per annum.

items.title: MHA Designates Shahzad Bhatti Network as Terrorist Organisation Under UAPA
items.summary: The Union Ministry of Home Affairs has designated the Shahzad Bhatti Network as a terrorist organisation under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act. The ministry notified that the group's activities pose a serious threat to national security, communal harmony, and the democratic system.

items.title: West Bengal Joins Union Government's PM Vishwakarma Scheme
items.summary: West Bengal has for the first time joined and launched the Union government's PM Vishwakarma Scheme. The state government also observed the launch event as Annapurna Divas.

items.title: PM Modi Addresses Semicon India 2026 on Semiconductor Manufacturing
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed Semicon India 2026, positioning India as a trustworthy destination for chipmaking amid concerns over supply chain weaponisation. He stressed that India's emergence as an electronics manufacturing hub will benefit the global economy.

items.title: New Cat Species 'Tilcayo' Identified in Bolivia
items.summary: A new cat species named 'Tilcayo' has been identified in Bolivia, marking the first such discovery in over a century. Genetic analysis indicates that the lineage separated from other tiger cats approximately 1.4 million years ago.

items.title: Moody's Raises India's FY27 GDP Growth Forecast to 7%
items.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7%, citing resilience despite geopolitical tensions in West Asia. The rating agency noted that elevated energy prices and El Niño-related food price pressures remain risks to inflation and growth.

items.title: Government Launches 16th Round of Commercial Auctions for 25 Coal Blocks
items.summary: The Government of India has put 25 coal blocks up for sale under the 16th round of commercial auctions. The offered mines are distributed across nine states, including Arunachal Pradesh, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, and Jharkhand.

items.title: Abhishek Sharma Scores Fastest T20 Century by an Indian
items.summary: Abhishek Sharma scored a 34-ball century against Afghanistan, setting the record for the fastest hundred by an Indian in full-member T20 matches. He broke the previous national record of a 35-ball century set by Rohit Sharma in 2017.

items.title: Astronomers Discover Youngest Known Planet Elias 2-24 b
items.summary: Astronomers have discovered Elias 2-24 b, which has been identified as the youngest known planet.

items.title: Ladakh Develops World's Highest-Altitude Flower Fields
items.summary: Ladakh has successfully developed the world's highest-altitude flower fields.

items.title: Scientists Identify Leopardus tilcayo in Bolivia
items.summary: Scientists have identified Leopardus tilcayo in Bolivia.

items.title: HAL Hands Over LCA Trainer Aircraft to IAF and Dhruv NG to Pawan Hans
items.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) handed over two LCA trainer planes to the Indian Air Force and four Dhruv Next Generation (NG) helicopters to Pawan Hans Limited. This marks the induction of the civil-certified Dhruv NG into civil aviation.

items.title: GRSE Launches Indigenous Ocean Research Vessel 'Sagar Manthan'
items.summary: Kolkata-based Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE) has launched 'Sagar Manthan', an indigenously built ocean research vessel. The ₹840-crore vessel is expected to be ready for operational use by early 2028.

items.title: Karnataka Approves Tulu as Second Administrative Language in Two Districts
items.summary: The Karnataka Cabinet has approved Tulu as the second administrative language for the Dakshina Kannada and Udupi districts.

items.title: JPC Questions Centre on FCRA Amendment Provisions
items.summary: Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC) members questioned the Centre regarding foreign funds and asset takeover provisions in proposed FCRA amendments. The Home Ministry defended the changes as steps to enhance transparency and accountability.

items.title: Supreme Court Petition Filed Against ECI Freeze on Party Symbol
items.summary: A petition was filed in the Supreme Court against the Election Commission of India's freeze on the Trinamool Congress symbol. The plea argues that the ECI relied on statements of rebel legislators subject to disqualification under the Tenth Schedule (anti-defection law).

items.title: Inaugural Carpathian Eight Regional Summit Hosted in Ukraine
items.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy hosted the inaugural summit of the 'Carpathian Eight' regional grouping. The summit brought together leaders from Ukraine, Romania, Serbia, Poland, Slovakia, the Czech Republic, Austria, and Hungary, along with involvement from the European Union.

items.title: India and Bhutan Review Bilateral Development Cooperation
items.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar met with his Bhutanese counterpart to discuss advancing multifaceted bilateral engagement. The two sides commended progress in development partnership, energy, trade, connectivity, culture, and people-to-people ties.

items.title: Denmark Inaugurates Greensand CO2 Storage Facility in North Sea
items.summary: Denmark has inaugurated Greensand in the North Sea, bringing the European Union's first full-scale carbon dioxide storage site and value chain into operation.

items.title: Bank of Japan Raises Interest Rates to 31-Year High
items.summary: The Bank of Japan has tightened monetary policy by raising interest rates to a 31-year high to battle inflation driven by rising oil prices from the West Asia crisis.

items.title: 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate Applied to UPI Transactions Above ₹2,000
items.summary: Starting October 15, a 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate will apply to person-to-merchant UPI payments exceeding ₹2,000, paid by merchants and capped at ₹300 for transactions of ₹75,000 or more.

items.title: NMDC Unveils Three-Phase Roadmap for Net Zero Operational Emissions by 2047
items.summary: NMDC has announced a three-phase roadmap spanning short, medium, and long-term phases from FY 2026 to FY 2047 to achieve Net Zero operational emissions.

items.title: Net Direct Tax Collection Rises 13% to Over ₹12.12 Lakh Crore
items.summary: Data from the Central Board of Direct Taxes shows net direct tax collection grew 13% to over ₹12.12 lakh crore, while refund issuance increased 29.19% to over ₹2.20 lakh crore.

items.title: Manu Bhaker and Tejinderpal Toor Named India's Flag-Bearers for Asian Games Opening Ceremony
items.summary: Manu Bhaker and Tejinderpal Toor have been named as India's flag-bearers for the Asian Games opening ceremony. Bhaker is the first athlete from independent India to win two medals in a single Olympics, while Toor has won gold in the last two Asian Games.

items.title: Cochin Shipyard Lays Keel for Next-Generation Missile Vessels
items.summary: Cochin Shipyard has laid the keel for Next-Generation Missile Vessels as part of naval defense manufacturing initiatives.

items.title: Scientists Discover DARE Cells Capable of Surviving Apoptosis
items.summary: Scientists have identified a new category of biological cells termed DARE cells that possess the ability to survive apoptosis.

items.title: Odisha government plans 870-Acre Silicon Valley hub in Cuttack’s Naraj for semiconductor, IT projects
items.summary: The State government has received investment proposals worth approximately Rs 23,600 crore and the potential to generate 6,100 employment opportunities, says Odisha CM

items.title: Bihar floods: Nitin Nabin donates three months’ Rajya Sabha MP salary to CM Relief Fund
items.summary: The State government has already distributed ₹550 crore in direct financial assistance by transferring ₹7,000 to each flood affected family, the BJP National President said

items.title: PM Modi, UAE Preident discuss West Asia, strategic partnership during phone call
items.summary: The Prime Minister and the UAE president reaffirmed their commitment to continued cooperation and coordination in efforts to promote regional peace, security and stability, a statement issued by the Prime Minister's Office said.

items.title: Four of a family returning from Ganesh immersion killed in road accident on NH-44 near Shamshabad
items.summary: The family was travelling from their native Mettugadda Thanda in Nawabpet mandal of Mahabubnagar to Shamshabad after Ganesh immersion when their Innova (TS 07 GZ 9333) allegedly rammed into a divider during the wee hours of Saturday.

items.title: How Chennai’s GCC expansion could reshape its real estate market
items.summary: As Global Capability Centres (GCC) expand across the city’s key corridors, demand for Grade A offices and housing is expected to grow alongside supporting infrastructure

items.title: Sharad Pawar urges Maharashtra government to declare drought, provide ₹50,000 per hectare relief
items.summary: Instead of taking a decision based solely on the average district figures, the actual damage should be considered together based on taluka-wise rainfall, crop condition, and declare drought, says NCP (SP) leader Sharad Pawar

items.title: Interests of a political party being served, says Mamata after losing TMC name and symbol; vows to fight back
items.summary: Senior BJP leaders including Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that it was divine intervention that Mamata Banerjee has lost her party’s symbol and name

items.title: What are the alternatives to SWIFT, and how are they faring? Explained
items.summary: Multiple wars and U.S. weaponisation of the dollar through financial sanctions are making countries in the Global South think of bypassing the so-far universally accepted SWIFT system for inter-country payments

items.title: Trump bans media outlets CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House
items.summary: “I am banning Fake News CNN, MSNOW... and Politico... from the White House,” the U.S. President said in a Truth Social post

items.title: California Governor signs order to explore AI 'kill switch'
items.summary: The federal government's abject failure to create any form of meaningful AI oversight or accountability should alarm every American, especially when AI CEOs themselves are begging for regulation, says Gavin Newsom

items.title: Bihar announces OTS scheme for brick kilns, waives ₹90 crore interest on outstanding dues
items.summary: Interest component will be waived off under OTS; It will benefit around 6000 brick kiln owners. It will be applicable for three months beginning Sep 21.

items.title: India rejects Pakistan’s allegations regarding collision of Indian, Pak ships in Arabian Sea
items.summary: The incident happened on the night of September 15, when a Pakistani vessel closed in on a frontline Indian Navy warship that was on a routine surveillance mission in the north Arabian Sea

items.title: Waste of public money amid economic crisis: U.P. Congress on PM’s birthday celebrations
items.summary: State unit chief Ajay Rai alleged that 500 bikes were given in Varanasi with a deal that the people who ride them will have to pay ₹700 per day

items.title: Meghalaya IPS officer injured in ‘deliberate’ hit by two-wheeler
items.summary: Police suspect members of the Khasi Students’ Union targeted Additional Superintendent of Police (Traffic) during a routine road check

items.title: Jhiram Valley Maoist attack case ‘rarest of rare': court order
items.summary: According to the September 16 verdict, the conspiracy behind the attack was finalised during a meeting of the South Regional Unified Command [of the Communist Party of India (Maoist)] held between February 16-25 in 2013
